explicacion: Revokes at once every valid QR code of the account, from all its users. Use it against suspicious use the account can't stop by itself.

dialogo.titulo: Revoke all the QR codes of {{cuenta}}
dialogo.resumen: All valid QR codes of {{cuenta}} ({{codigo}}) will be revoked, from all its users. Revoked QR codes stop working: whoever holds one will have to ask for a new one.
dialogo.motivoAyuda: It is recorded in the account's audit log.

resultado.ninguno: There were no valid QR codes: nothing was revoked.
